Furthermore, the reasoning in the analysis claims Eliran Glazer was the CEO during the IPO and Nir Rosen joined later; while partially true regarding the timeline, the *current* CEO of monday.com is Gil Shwed, not Eliran Glazer (who stepped down years ago). The analysis fails to correctly identify that the agent is currently stuck in a search loop rather than having produced a final hallucinated fact yet.
